verdict.rationale: Ramp documents AI agents for auto-coding, receipt capture with AI-filled memos, invoice-to-PO matching with GL coding, and categorization that learns from history and syncs coded transactions to the ERP. It also cites real-time bidirectional ERP sync that eliminates manual journal entries, 100% auto-reconciliation of Ramp payments, and a syncable banking-transactions endpoint, which together cover the core month-end close work. Missing for 10: an explicit month-end close workflow (close checklist, accruals, close-status tracking), any measured close-time reduction, and independent or hands-on corroboration that close is actually faster.
